policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: The issue-666 fix preserves explicit BCP-47 language regions (pt-BR, en-US, es-MX) in media language tags and adds the shared media-language core module with its regional-flag coverage. Rebased onto current main; the official CI client coverage gate measured 2,918/3,304 (88.317%) on this exact tree. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

This branch changes no server code; the server profile is inherited from main. Four clean CI coverage runs on the 53,174-line scope have observed 43,470, 43,472, 43,473 and 43,476 covered lines. The six-line envelope is timing-dependent branch coverage in the tag-cache monitor's asynchronous invalidation paths, not a source or test difference; the spread is 0.011 percentage points, far inside the 0.15pp policy bound. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
